newsitem.title: GERMANY: Holzmann to axe 10 percent of German workforce.
newsitem.headline: Holzmann to axe 10 percent of German workforce.

text.p: Philipp Holzmann AG, Germany's largest building group, said Wednesday it would shed up to 10 percent of its domestic workforce this year amid a slump in the construction sector.
The builder said it was cutting jobs partly because fierce competition was forcing it to make increased use of subcontractors that pay lower wages.
The company's domestic workforce totalled 24,168 last year. It employed 27,052 people abroad.
Chief Executive Lothar Mayer said the job losses would occur independently of the planned sale of holdings that now account for 10 percent of construction output.
He painted a dire picture of the domestic building industry this year and predicted Holzmann's new business would decline, while output was likely to stagnate at the 1996 level.
